tasks.title: Question 31
tasks.promptText: Jonah wants to talk about family photo. which place to choose. what pose to try. when to take it.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English friend Jonah.

promptBlocks.subject: Photo day
paragraphs: I am writing about family photo. which place to choose? what pose to try?
when to take it? Please write soon.

promptBlocks.text: Write an email to Jonah and answer the questions.

tasks.title: Question 32
tasks.promptText: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures.

ketImageBrief.title: family photo
ketImageBrief.panel1: Jonah starts family photo with a clear plan.
ketImageBrief.panel2: A small problem changes the plan.
ketImageBrief.panel3: Jonah solves it and finishes happily.
continuityNotes: Keep the same child and objects in all three panels.
